_comment: Standalone single-file AIO egg (Beta v0.4). Fixes portable MySQL 8.4 secure-file-priv, Pelican install/runtime config paths, and DBUpdater SourceDirectory/MySQLExecutable runtime fallbacks.
name: AzerothCore WotLK - Standalone AIO
author: Nazgile94 / AI-assisted
description: Single-file Pelican AIO (Beta v0.4): builds AzerothCore during installation, bundles MySQL 8.4 runtime + required libraries, downloads client data, supports module branches and optional PlayerBots. Uses only public Pelican base images. Fixes portable MySQL paths and pins DBUpdater SourceDirectory/MySQLExecutable to runtime paths. AI-assisted development.

installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

SERVER_ROOT="/mnt/server"
SRC="${SERVER_ROOT}/azerothcore"
AIO_DIR="${SERVER_ROOT}/.aio"
MYSQL_HOME="${AIO_DIR}/mysql"
RUNTIME_LIB="${AIO_DIR}/lib"
LOG_DIR="${SERVER_ROOT}/logs"
SECRET_DIR="${SERVER_ROOT}/.secrets"

ACORE_REPO="${ACORE_REPO:-https://github.com/azerothcore/azerothcore-wotlk.git}"
ACORE_BRANCH="${ACORE_BRANCH:-master}"
ACORE_MODULES="${ACORE_MODULES:-}"
BUILD_THREADS="${BUILD_THREADS:-2}"
KEEP_BUILD_CACHE="${KEEP_BUILD_CACHE:-0}"
MODULE_CONFIG_AUTO_COPY="${MODULE_CONFIG_AUTO_COPY:-1}"
USE_PLAYERBOTS="${USE_PLAYERBOTS:-0}"
PLAYERBOTS_CORE_REPO="https://github.com/mod-playerbots/azerothcore-wotlk.git"
PLAYERBOTS_CORE_BRANCH="${PLAYERBOTS_CORE_BRANCH:-Playerbot}"
PLAYERBOTS_MODULE_REPO="https://github.com/mod-playerbots/mod-playerbots.git"
PLAYERBOTS_MODULE_BRANCH="${PLAYERBOTS_MODULE_BRANCH:-master}"
MYSQL_APT_CONFIG_VERSION="${MYSQL_APT_CONFIG_VERSION:-0.8.36-1}"

say() { printf '\n[AzerothCore Standalone Installer] %s\n' "$*"; }
die() { printf '\n[AzerothCore Standalone Installer] FEHLER: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
is_uint() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; }
is_bool() { [[ "$1" == "0" || "$1" == "1" ]]; }
sha256_text() { printf '%s' "$1" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'; }

is_uint "$BUILD_THREADS" && (( BUILD_THREADS >= 1 && BUILD_THREADS <= 64 )) || die "BUILD_THREADS muss zwischen 1 und 64 liegen."
for b in KEEP_BUILD_CACHE MODULE_CONFIG_AUTO_COPY USE_PLAYERBOTS; do
    is_bool "${!b}" || die "$b muss 0 oder 1 sein."
done
[[ "$ACORE_REPO" =~ ^https://[^[:space:]]+$ ]] || die "ACORE_REPO muss eine HTTPS-Git-URL sein."
[[ "$ACORE_BRANCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ ]] || die "ACORE_BRANCH enthaelt ungueltige Zeichen."
[[ "$PLAYERBOTS_CORE_BRANCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ ]] || die "PLAYERBOTS_CORE_BRANCH enthaelt ungueltige Zeichen."
[[ "$PLAYERBOTS_MODULE_BRANCH" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ ]] || die "PLAYERBOTS_MODULE_BRANCH enthaelt ungueltige Zeichen."
[[ "$MYSQL_APT_CONFIG_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9.]+-[0-9]+$ ]] || die "MYSQL_APT_CONFIG_VERSION hat ein ungueltiges Format."

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64|aarch64|arm64) ;;
    *) die "Diese Standalone-Version unterstuetzt aktuell nur x86_64/amd64 und arm64/aarch64." ;;
esac

if [[ "$USE_PLAYERBOTS" == "1" ]]; then
    [[ "$ACORE_MODULES" != *"$PLAYERBOTS_MODULE_REPO"* ]] || die "Bei USE_PLAYERBOTS=1 wird mod-playerbots automatisch installiert. Bitte entferne die PlayerBots-URL aus ACORE_MODULES, damit sie nicht doppelt eingebaut wird."
    EFFECTIVE_REPO="$PLAYERBOTS_CORE_REPO"
    EFFECTIVE_BRANCH="$PLAYERBOTS_CORE_BRANCH"
    EFFECTIVE_MODULES="${ACORE_MODULES:+${ACORE_MODULES} }${PLAYERBOTS_MODULE_REPO} --branch=${PLAYERBOTS_MODULE_BRANCH}"
else
    EFFECTIVE_REPO="$ACORE_REPO"
    EFFECTIVE_BRANCH="$ACORE_BRANCH"
    EFFECTIVE_MODULES="$ACORE_MODULES"
fi

mkdir -p "$SERVER_ROOT" "$AIO_DIR" "$RUNTIME_LIB" "$LOG_DIR" "$SECRET_DIR"
chmod 700 "$SECRET_DIR" 2>/dev/null || true

if [[ -e "$SRC" && ! -d "$SRC/.git" ]]; then
    die "${SRC} existiert bereits, ist aber kein Git-Checkout. Aus Sicherheitsgruenden wird nichts ueberschrieben."
fi
if [[ -d "$SRC/.git" ]]; then
    die "Es existiert bereits eine AzerothCore-Installation. Das Standalone-Egg ist fuer Neuinstallationen gedacht und ueberschreibt vorhandene Server nicht."
fi

say "Installiere Build-Abhaengigkeiten im temporaeren Pelican-Installer ..."
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates curl wget git cmake make gcc g++ clang \
    libssl-dev libbz2-dev libreadline-dev libncurses-dev libboost-all-dev \
    lsb-release gnupg xz-utils tar rsync pkg-config file binutils patchelf \
    libnuma1

# libaio package name differs between Debian releases.
if ! apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libaio1t64; then
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libaio1
fi

say "Aktiviere das offizielle MySQL-Apt-Repository und installiere MySQL 8.4 LTS ..."
# Prevent package post-install scripts from trying to start services in the installer container.
POLICY_BACKUP=""
if [[ -e /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d ]]; then
    POLICY_BACKUP="/tmp/policy-rc.d.aio-backup"
    cp -a /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d "$POLICY_BACKUP"
fi
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexit 101\n' > /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
chmod +x /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
cd /tmp
MYSQL_APT_DEB="mysql-apt-config_${MYSQL_APT_CONFIG_VERSION}_all.deb"
curl -fL --retry 4 --retry-delay 3 "https://dev.mysql.com/get/${MYSQL_APT_DEB}" -o "$MYSQL_APT_DEB"
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive dpkg -i "$MYSQL_APT_DEB"
apt-get update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends mysql-server libmysqlclient-dev
if [[ -n "$POLICY_BACKUP" ]]; then
    mv -f "$POLICY_BACKUP" /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
else
    rm -f /usr/sbin/policy-rc.d
fi

MYSQL_VERSION_TEXT="$(mysqld --version 2>/dev/null || true)"
[[ "$MYSQL_VERSION_TEXT" =~ Ver[[:space:]]+8\.4\. ]] || die "Erwartet wurde MySQL 8.4 LTS, installiert wurde: ${MYSQL_VERSION_TEXT:-unbekannt}. Abbruch statt eine ungetestete MySQL-Version zu verwenden."
say "Gefunden: ${MYSQL_VERSION_TEXT}"

say "Klone Core ${EFFECTIVE_REPO} (${EFFECTIVE_BRANCH}) ..."
git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "$EFFECTIVE_BRANCH" "$EFFECTIVE_REPO" "$SRC"
cd "$SRC"

clone_module() {
    local url="$1"
    local branch="${2:-}"
    local name dest
    [[ "$url" =~ ^https://[^[:space:]]+$ ]] || die "Erwartete HTTPS-Modul-URL, erhalten: '$url'."
    [[ -z "$branch" || "$branch" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$ ]] || die "Ungueltiger Modul-Branch '$branch' fuer $url."
    name="$(basename "$url")"
    name="${name%.git}"
    [[ "$name" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ ]] || die "Ungueltiger Modulname aus URL: $url"
    dest="modules/$name"
    [[ ! -e "$dest" ]] || die "Modulziel existiert doppelt: $dest"
    if [[ -n "$branch" ]]; then
        say "Installiere Modul ${name} (Branch ${branch}) ..."
        git clone --depth 1 --single-branch --branch "$branch" "$url" "$dest"
    else
        say "Installiere Modul ${name} ..."
        git clone --depth 1 "$url" "$dest"
    fi
}

if [[ -n "$EFFECTIVE_MODULES" ]]; then
    say "Installiere konfigurierte Module ..."
    mkdir -p modules
    module_text="${EFFECTIVE_MODULES//$'\n'/ }"
    read -r -a module_tokens <<< "$module_text"
    i=0
    while (( i < ${#module_tokens[@]} )); do
        url="${module_tokens[$i]}"
        i=$((i + 1))
        branch=""
        [[ "$url" =~ ^https://[^[:space:]]+$ ]] || die "Erwartete Modul-URL, erhalten: '$url'. Syntax: https://.../mod.git [--branch=BRANCH]"
        if (( i < ${#module_tokens[@]} )); then
            case "${module_tokens[$i]}" in
                --branch=*)
                    branch="${module_tokens[$i]#--branch=}"
                    i=$((i + 1))
                    ;;
                --branch)
                    (( i + 1 < ${#module_tokens[@]} )) || die "--branch benoetigt einen Branch-Namen."
                    branch="${module_tokens[$((i + 1))]}"
                    i=$((i + 2))
                    ;;
            esac
        fi
        clone_module "$url" "$branch"
    done
fi

say "Baue AzerothCore mit ${BUILD_THREADS} Thread(s) ..."
export MTHREADS="$BUILD_THREADS"
export SKIP_MYSQL_INSTALL=true
export AC_CCACHE=false
export CTYPE=Release
export CAPPS_BUILD=all
export CTOOLS_BUILD=db-only
./acore.sh compiler all

for binary in worldserver authserver dbimport; do
    [[ -x "$SRC/env/dist/bin/$binary" ]] || die "$binary wurde nicht gebaut."
done

say "Lade Client-Daten (DBC/Maps/VMaps/MMaps) ..."
CLIENT_DATA_DIR="$SRC/env/dist/bin"
DATAPATH="$CLIENT_DATA_DIR" ./acore.sh client-data
for data_dir in dbc maps vmaps mmaps; do
    [[ -d "$CLIENT_DATA_DIR/$data_dir" ]] || die "Client-Daten fehlen nach Download: ${CLIENT_DATA_DIR}/${data_dir}"
    find "$CLIENT_DATA_DIR/$data_dir" -type f -print -quit | grep -q . || die "Client-Daten-Verzeichnis ist leer: ${CLIENT_DATA_DIR}/${data_dir}"
done

ETC="$SRC/env/dist/etc"
mkdir -p "$ETC" "$SRC/env/dist/logs" "$SRC/env/dist/temp"
[[ -f "$ETC/authserver.conf" ]] || cp "$ETC/authserver.conf.dist" "$ETC/authserver.conf"
[[ -f "$ETC/worldserver.conf" ]] || cp "$ETC/worldserver.conf.dist" "$ETC/worldserver.conf"
if [[ -f "$ETC/dbimport.conf.dist" && ! -f "$ETC/dbimport.conf" ]]; then
    cp "$ETC/dbimport.conf.dist" "$ETC/dbimport.conf"
fi
if [[ "$MODULE_CONFIG_AUTO_COPY" == "1" && -d "$ETC/modules" ]]; then
    while IFS= read -r -d '' dist_conf; do
        real_conf="${dist_conf%.dist}"
        [[ -f "$real_conf" ]] || cp "$dist_conf" "$real_conf"
    done < <(find "$ETC/modules" -type f -name '*.conf.dist' -print0)
fi

say "Packe MySQL 8.4 als persistente lokale Runtime ..."
rm -rf "$MYSQL_HOME"
mkdir -p "$MYSQL_HOME/bin" "$MYSQL_HOME/lib" "$MYSQL_HOME/share"
cp -L "$(command -v mysqld)" "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysqld"
cp -L "$(command -v mysql)" "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysql"
cp -L "$(command -v mysqladmin)" "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysqladmin"
chmod +x "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysqld" "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysql" "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysqladmin"
[[ -d /usr/lib/mysql ]] && cp -a /usr/lib/mysql/. "$MYSQL_HOME/lib/"
[[ -d /usr/share/mysql ]] && cp -a /usr/share/mysql/. "$MYSQL_HOME/share/"

say "Sammle benoetigte Shared Libraries fuer Core und MySQL ..."
rm -rf "$RUNTIME_LIB"
mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_LIB"

is_system_glibc_lib() {
    case "$1" in
        libc.so.*|libm.so.*|libpthread.so.*|libdl.so.*|librt.so.*|libresolv.so.*|libnss_*.so.*|libutil.so.*|ld-linux*.so.*) return 0 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

copy_ldd_deps() {
    local binary="$1"
    local output lib base
    output="$(LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$MYSQL_HOME/lib:$MYSQL_HOME/lib/private:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}" ldd "$binary" 2>&1)" || {
        printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
        die "ldd konnte Abhaengigkeiten nicht lesen: $binary"
    }
    if grep -q 'not found' <<< "$output"; then
        printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
        die "Nicht aufloesbare Shared Library fuer $binary."
    fi
    while IFS= read -r lib; do
        [[ -n "$lib" && -f "$lib" ]] || continue
        base="$(basename "$lib")"
        if is_system_glibc_lib "$base"; then
            continue
        fi
        cp -Lf "$lib" "$RUNTIME_LIB/$base"
    done < <(awk '/=> \/[^ ]+/ {print $3} /^\// {print $1}' <<< "$output" | sort -u)
}

for binary in \
    "$SRC/env/dist/bin/worldserver" \
    "$SRC/env/dist/bin/authserver" \
    "$SRC/env/dist/bin/dbimport" \
    "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysqld" \
    "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysql" \
    "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysqladmin"; do
    copy_ldd_deps "$binary"
done

if [[ -d "$MYSQL_HOME/lib/plugin" ]]; then
    while IFS= read -r -d '' plugin; do
        copy_ldd_deps "$plugin"
    done < <(find "$MYSQL_HOME/lib/plugin" -type f -name '*.so' -print0)
fi

# Keep any libraries installed by AzerothCore itself.
if [[ -d "$SRC/env/dist/lib" ]]; then
    cp -a "$SRC/env/dist/lib/." "$RUNTIME_LIB/" || true
fi

OSSL_MODULE_DIR="$(find /usr/lib -maxdepth 3 -type d -name ossl-modules -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -n "$OSSL_MODULE_DIR" ]]; then
    rm -rf "$AIO_DIR/ossl-modules"
    cp -a "$OSSL_MODULE_DIR" "$AIO_DIR/ossl-modules"
fi
[[ -f /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf ]] && cp -L /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf "$AIO_DIR/openssl.cnf"

# Verify the copied MySQL runtime while installer libraries are still available.
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$RUNTIME_LIB:$MYSQL_HOME/lib:$MYSQL_HOME/lib/private:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
PACKED_MYSQL_VERSION="$("$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysqld" --version 2>/dev/null || true)"
[[ "$PACKED_MYSQL_VERSION" =~ Ver[[:space:]]+8\.4\. ]] || die "Die gepackte MySQL-Runtime ist nicht MySQL 8.4: $PACKED_MYSQL_VERSION"

say "Erzeuge eingebettetes Runtime-Startscript ..."
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > "$SERVER_ROOT/start.sh"
chmod +x "$SERVER_ROOT/start.sh"

MODULES_SHA256="$(sha256_text "$ACORE_MODULES")"
{
    printf 'PROFILE_VERSION=%q\n' '1'
    printf 'PROFILE_USE_PLAYERBOTS=%q\n' "$USE_PLAYERBOTS"
    printf 'PROFILE_ACORE_REPO=%q\n' "$ACORE_REPO"
    printf 'PROFILE_ACORE_BRANCH=%q\n' "$ACORE_BRANCH"
    printf 'PROFILE_PLAYERBOTS_CORE_BRANCH=%q\n' "$PLAYERBOTS_CORE_BRANCH"
    printf 'PROFILE_PLAYERBOTS_MODULE_BRANCH=%q\n' "$PLAYERBOTS_MODULE_BRANCH"
    printf 'PROFILE_MODULES_SHA256=%q\n' "$MODULES_SHA256"
    printf 'PROFILE_EFFECTIVE_REPO=%q\n' "$EFFECTIVE_REPO"
    printf 'PROFILE_EFFECTIVE_BRANCH=%q\n' "$EFFECTIVE_BRANCH"
    printf 'PROFILE_MYSQL_VERSION=%q\n' "$PACKED_MYSQL_VERSION"
} > "$AIO_DIR/install-profile.env"
chmod 600 "$AIO_DIR/install-profile.env" 2>/dev/null || true

cat > "$SERVER_ROOT/STANDALONE-AIO-INFO.txt" <<INFO
AzerothCore Pelican Standalone All-in-One
========================================
This installation was created entirely by the Egg installer.
No project-specific Docker image or repository is required at runtime.

Runtime base image:
  ghcr.io/pelican-eggs/yolks:debian

Installed core:
  ${EFFECTIVE_REPO}
  branch: ${EFFECTIVE_BRANCH}

PlayerBots:
  ${USE_PLAYERBOTS}

Persistent directories:
  azerothcore/  - source, installed binaries, configs, client data
  .aio/         - bundled MySQL 8.4 runtime and shared libraries
  mysql/        - MySQL data directory (created on first start)
  logs/         - MySQL logs
  .secrets/     - generated DB password when ACORE_DB_PASSWORD=auto

IMPORTANT:
  ACORE_REPO, ACORE_BRANCH, ACORE_MODULES, USE_PLAYERBOTS and PlayerBots branches
  are BUILD-TIME settings in this standalone edition. Changing them later requires
  a new build. Runtime/gameplay variables can be changed normally.
INFO

if [[ "$KEEP_BUILD_CACHE" == "0" ]]; then
    say "Entferne Compiler-Buildcache, um Speicherplatz zu sparen ..."
    rm -rf "$SRC/var/build"
fi

say "Fuehre abschliessende Integritaetspruefungen aus ..."
bash -n "$SERVER_ROOT/start.sh"
for f in "$SRC/env/dist/bin/worldserver" "$SRC/env/dist/bin/authserver" "$SRC/env/dist/bin/dbimport" "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysqld" "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysql" "$MYSQL_HOME/bin/mysqladmin"; do
    [[ -x "$f" ]] || die "Abschlusspruefung fehlgeschlagen: $f"
done
for d in dbc maps vmaps mmaps; do
    find "$CLIENT_DATA_DIR/$d" -type f -print -quit | grep -q . || die "Abschlusspruefung: Client-Daten fehlen in $d"
done

say "Installation abgeschlossen. Beim ersten Start werden MySQL-Datenbanken initialisiert und dbimport ausgefuehrt."

variables.name: Realm Address
variables.description: Oeffentliche IP oder DNS fuer WoW-Clients. 'auto' nutzt Pelicans SERVER_IP.

variables.name: Worldserver Port Override
variables.description: Leer/0 = Primary Allocation (SERVER_PORT). Bei anderem Wert muss der Port als Pelican-Allocation existieren.

variables.name: Authserver Port
variables.description: Authserver TCP-Port. Standard fuer WoW 3.3.5a: 3724. Als zusaetzliche TCP-Allocation bereitstellen.

variables.name: Realm Type
variables.description: Realmtyp: 0/4 Normal, 1 PvP, 6 RP, 8 RP-PvP, 16 FFA-PvP.

variables.name: DBC Locale
variables.description: 255=Auto; 0=enUS, 2=frFR, 3=deDE, 6=esES, 8=ruRU. Bei PlayerBots wird automatisch enUS (0) erzwungen.

variables.name: Characters Per Realm
variables.description: Charaktere pro Realm; der 3.3.5a-Client zeigt maximal 10.

variables.name: Characters Per Account
variables.description: Gesamtlimit pro Account; muss >= Characters Per Realm sein.

variables.name: Allow Two-Side Accounts
variables.description: 1 erlaubt Horde und Allianz auf demselben Account/Realm.

variables.name: Log IP Addresses in Database
variables.description: 1 erlaubt IP-Logging in der Datenbank, 0 deaktiviert es.

variables.name: AzerothCore DB Password
variables.description: 'auto' erzeugt beim ersten Start ein persistentes zufaelliges internes Passwort.

variables.name: MySQL Port
variables.description: Interner MySQL-Port. Nur extern bereitstellen, wenn MYSQL_REMOTE_ACCESS=1.

variables.name: MySQL Remote Access
variables.description: 0 = nur 127.0.0.1; 1 = 0.0.0.0. Bei 1 Allocation und Firewall absichern.

variables.name: Use PlayerBots [INSTALL]
variables.description: Vor der Installation waehlen. 0 = normaler AzerothCore-Core. 1 = PlayerBots-Core-Fork (Playerbot) + mod-playerbots. Nach der Installation nicht umschalten.

variables.name: PlayerBots Core Branch [INSTALL]
variables.description: Installationsoption. Standard: Playerbot. Nur vor der Installation aendern.

variables.name: AzerothCore Modules [INSTALL]
variables.description: Module werden waehrend der Installation kompiliert. HTTPS-Git-URLs; optional --branch=BRANCH oder --branch BRANCH direkt hinter der URL. Nach Installation nicht aendern.

variables.name: Auto-create Module Configs
variables.description: 1 kopiert *.conf.dist nach *.conf, ohne bestehende Configs zu ueberschreiben.

variables.name: Keep Build Cache [INSTALL]
variables.description: 0 entfernt den grossen Compiler-Buildcache nach erfolgreicher Installation; 1 behaelt ihn. Fuer die Standalone-Runtime wird er nicht benoetigt.

variables.name: AzerothCore Branch [INSTALL]
variables.description: Branch des normalen AzerothCore-Repositories. Bei USE_PLAYERBOTS=1 wird der PlayerBots-Core-Branch verwendet.

variables.name: AzerothCore Repository [INSTALL]
variables.description: Core-Repository fuer den normalen Modus. Bei USE_PLAYERBOTS=1 wird automatisch der PlayerBots-Fork verwendet.
